result.title: CreditFilter: Calibrated Token Weights over the Within-Response Entropy Rank for RLVR
result.summary: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically assigns a uniform advantage to every token. Token-reweighting heuristics like the 80/20 mask favor high-entropy tokens, but fail to measure a token's actual impact on the outcome. We formalize this impact as the forking value: the variance of the success probability over the policy's next-token choices. The expected forking values along a response sum exactly to the reward variance. Token credit is thus, in expectation over a prompt's responses, a fixed budget spent at the forks. This motivates weights that redistribute credit within a response. The forking value factorizes into a fork consequence, which requires costly continuations to estimate, and a fork probability, which the softmax provides. On Qwen3-8B-Base, this fork probability decays exponentially with a token's within-response entropy rank at class-specific rates, revealing that most tokens carry negligible forking value. CreditFilter weights each token by an exponential window over the same rank. The window is calibrated to this fork-probability envelope, under an approximately flat fork consequence. CreditFilter needs no extra forward passes and is stabilized by difficulty damping and an entropy-gated fallback. Averaged over three seeds, it outperforms DAPO by 7.7 points on MATH500 and by 10.5 and 9.1 points on AIME24 and AIME25. Its dynamically adaptive variant matches it. The ablations show that both parts matter: ranking tokens within each response rather than across the batch, and matching the window's decay rate to the envelope. Code is available at https://github.com/yoctta/CreditFilter.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 RLVR 中把单个 token 对结果的贡献形式化为「forking value」（下一 token 选择上成功概率的方差），并据此提出 CreditFilter：按响应内熵排名设置指数窗口对 token 加权，窗口速率对齐观测到的 fork 概率衰减，在 MATH500、AIME 上超过 DAPO。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本训练的 token 级贡献分配方法，其「按响应内熵排名重分配信用」的思路或可迁移到 latent 推理步骤或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 一类决策位置的监督权重，但 fork 价值近似在存在视觉旁路或多步 latent 状态时是否成立尚待核查。
